# proc

> proc runs child processes from Deno the way a shell pipes them, with errors that reach one `catch`. It also gives any async iterable the Array methods you already know: `map`, `filter`, `reduce`, `take`, and concurrent versions of `map`.

Deno library, version 0.28.2, on JSR as `@j50n/proc` (`deno add jsr:@j50n/proc`). Data transforms are a separate entry point, `@j50n/proc/transforms`. Read "Key ideas" first: it covers how every part behaves and the traps.

- [The whole book as one file](https://j50n.github.io/deno-proc/llms-full.txt)
- [API reference on JSR](https://jsr.io/@j50n/proc/doc)
